notes.title: Playtest Patch! Update Overview!
notes.notes:
What's up, Moneymakers!🧺💸  


The Laundering Simulator Playtest has been updated to version v05.09.2025.010 with the following changes:💸🧼


🆕 New Features
Added a video tutorial for dry cleaning – making the process easier to master.

Introduced a video tutorial for the money counterfeiting machine.

Highlighted tutorial arrows in the UI for clearer guidance.

New keyboard shortcut – press Spacebar to confirm transactions at the cash register.
✨ Improvements
Expanded and refined descriptions for washing machine repair and maintenance.

Added a sound effect to floating text for better feedback.

Improved object collision handling for smoother interactions.
🔧 Fixes
Fixed the broken washing machine indicator that was not displaying correctly.
